verdict.rationale: INPI is a national IP office portal for filing trademarks, patents, designs and e-Soleau, searching IP databases, and handling business formalities. It is not a workflow or automation platform. Versioning, reviewing and rolling back user-built automations is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows it offers any user-defined automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
